title: Trace feature
description: The general spine (proposal B4). Every feature in every domain has this shape, which is what lets rendering, the time slider, and cross-layer analysis stay domain-agnostic. Adding a domain adds a `domain` value and a hue — never a field.

id.description: Stable within a domain and a pipeline run. Used to key selection state.

properties.$comment: `valid_to` is required but nullable: an extractor that simply omits it would make every feature look current, which is a silent data error rather than a loud one. `subtype` is genuinely optional — proposal B4 marks it so, and not every domain has a meaningful finer class.

domain.description: Which subject this feature belongs to. Drives the cover hue.

subtype.description: Optional finer class within the domain — pond, reservoir, river, coast.

valid_from.description: Year the state begins. An integer year, not a date: every v1 source is annual. A date string would imply precision the 30 m annual sources do not have.

valid_to.description: The first year the state no longer holds — half-open. null means open-ended: the state is current as of the source's last observed year.
valid_to.$comment: Change-kind features must carry null; this is enforced in code because JSON Schema cannot condition on x-kind.

change_type.description: The universal state signal has two kinds: cover is the baseline state, while stable, gain, and loss are accumulated changes. Rendering colour is a pure function of (domain hue, change_type): every state is a transform of its domain's hue via styleFor(hue, change_type).
change_type.$comment: Cover carries its own validity; change accumulates and never closes; valid_to is half-open.

metric.description: Quantified magnitude. At least one measure must be present — a feature with no number cannot answer "how much", which is the product's whole claim.

source.description: Dataset and version, e.g. "UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2025_v1_13". Carried per feature so a mixed tileset stays attributable.

method.description: How this feature was derived — "JRC GSW YearlyHistory", or a segmentation model id. Makes the extraction reproducible and auditable.

confidence.description: 0–1. Surfaced in the UI rather than smoothed over (A5).

allOf.description: A state that has ended cannot end before it began.

then.$comment: Ordering (valid_to > valid_from) is enforced in code; JSON Schema cannot compare two sibling values.
